description: Land Title Settlement Department - Ellakkala, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510601
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, ownership details, and encumbrances) in various villages and divisions. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property rights, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
